$description: Component tokens that change with the theme (dark): only values a project may need to tune per component.

info-surface.$description: A faint, translucent info tint, so a full-width callout stays quiet on any surface.

info-border.$description: A translucent info hairline around the callout.

success-surface.$description: A faint, translucent success tint, so a full-width callout stays quiet on any surface.

success-border.$description: A translucent success hairline around the callout.

warning-surface.$description: A faint, translucent warning tint, so a full-width callout stays quiet on any surface.

warning-border.$description: A translucent warning hairline around the callout.

danger-surface.$description: A faint, translucent danger tint, so a full-width callout stays quiet on any surface.

danger-border.$description: A translucent danger hairline around the callout.
